tools.name: publish_doc
tools.description: Publish Markdown as a beautifully typeset page and receive its https://lucid.page/<slug> URL. Works anonymously; with an lp_ API key the page is owned by the account and can be updated later. Anonymous publishes return a one-time claim_token — hand your human the claim link https://lucid.page/claim?

tools.name: update_doc
tools.description: Replace the Markdown of a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stays the same; every update is kept as a revision.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch the canonical Markdown source of a page. Public and unlisted pages are open to anyone; private pages require the owner's lp_ API key.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List the documents and bundles owned by the authenticated account (requires an lp_ API key), newest first, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: delete_doc
tools.description: Permanently delete a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stops serving immediately and cannot be recovered.

tools.name: create_bundle
tools.description: Bind documents you own into a multi-chapter bundle with its own landing page and ordered chapter navigation (requires an lp_ API key). Up to 200 chapters.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Show the lucid.page account matrix (anonymous vs lp_ API key) and, when a key is present, the caller's current plan status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_doc · Private data: publish_doc, update_doc, get_doc, list_docs, delete_doc, create_bundle, get_limits · Public sink: publish_doc · Destructive: delete_doc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_doc · Private data: publish_doc, update_doc, get_doc, list_docs, delete_doc, create_bundle, get_limits · Public sink: publish_doc · Destructive: delete_doc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
